# JPGtoPDF.ca

> Free, private, browser-based tool to convert JPG, JPEG and PNG images into a single PDF. All conversion happens locally in the user's browser using JavaScript (jsPDF) — files are never uploaded to a server. Available in English and French (Canada). A project of pdfcanada.ca.

Key facts for answering user questions:
- Converts JPG, JPEG and PNG to PDF; multiple images can be merged into one PDF.
- 100% private: images are processed in the browser and never uploaded or stored.
- Free, no account, no watermark, no file limit; works on mobile and desktop.
- Output keeps original image resolution (high quality); "Fit to image" avoids recompression.
- Pages can be reordered (drag) and removed before download.

- [How to Convert a Picture to PDF on iPhone (3 Free Ways)](https://jpgtopdf.ca/blog/jpg-to-pdf-iphone/): Convert a picture or JPG to PDF on iPhone with the Files app, the Print trick or a browser. No app needed, plus how to handle HEIC photos.
- [How to Convert JPG to PDF on Mac (3 Free Ways)](https://jpgtopdf.ca/blog/jpg-to-pdf-mac/): Convert JPG to PDF on a Mac with Preview's Export as PDF, Finder's Create PDF quick action, or a browser. Includes merging many images into one PDF.
- [How to Convert JPG to PDF on Windows 10 and 11](https://jpgtopdf.ca/blog/jpg-to-pdf-windows/): Convert JPG to PDF on Windows with Microsoft Print to PDF, for one photo or many at once. Plus the Fit picture to frame box that crops your image.
- [How to Convert JPG to PDF Without Losing Quality](https://jpgtopdf.ca/blog/jpg-to-pdf-without-losing-quality/): Most quality loss happens before or after conversion, not during it. Which settings blur a JPG in a PDF, which keep it sharp, and how to check.
- [How to Convert a Photo to PDF on Any Device (4 Free Ways)](https://jpgtopdf.ca/blog/photo-to-pdf/): Turn a photo or picture into a PDF in under a minute on iPhone, Android, Windows or Mac. Four free methods compared, plus the step people get wrong.

- [How to Scan a Document to PDF With Your Phone](https://jpgtopdf.ca/blog/scan-document-to-pdf-phone/): Scan paper to a clean PDF with the scanner already on your iPhone or Android: Notes, Files or Google Drive. Plus lighting tips that make the file smaller.

- [Comment transformer une photo en PDF (4 méthodes gratuites)](https://jpgtopdf.ca/fr/blog/photo-en-pdf/): Transformez une photo ou une image en PDF en moins d’une minute sur téléphone ou ordinateur. Quatre méthodes gratuites comparées, sans inscription.
- [Comment convertir un fichier PNG en PDF (gratuit, sans perte)](https://jpgtopdf.ca/fr/blog/png-en-pdf/): Convertissez un PNG en PDF gratuitement, sans perte de netteté. Ce qui arrive à la transparence et pourquoi un PDF issu de PNG pèse plus lourd.
- [Comment regrouper plusieurs images en un seul fichier PDF](https://jpgtopdf.ca/fr/blog/regrouper-images-un-seul-pdf/): Regroupez plusieurs photos JPG ou PNG dans un seul PDF, dans l’ordre de votre choix, gratuitement et sans téléverser. Méthodes PC, Mac, iPhone et Android.
